presentationProfile.title: TidyCal
presentationProfile.description: TidyCal is an online scheduling tool for booking pages, appointment management, and paid bookings

add-team-user.description: Invites a user to the specified team by email.

cancel-booking.description: Cancels the booking identified by the booking ID.

create-booking.description: Creates one booking with starts_at or package sessions with bookings[]. The array takes precedence; data returns a booking object or array, respectively.

create-booking-type.description: Creates a booking type for the authenticated account.

create-contact.description: Creates a contact for the authenticated account.

create-team-booking-type.description: Creates a booking type for the specified team.

get-account.description: Returns account details for the authenticated user.

get-booking.description: Returns the booking identified by the booking ID.

get-team.description: Returns details for the specified team.

list-booking-type-timeslots.description: Lists available time slots for the specified booking type.

list-booking-types.description: Lists booking types available to the authenticated account.

list-bookings.description: Lists bookings for the authenticated account.

list-contacts.description: Lists contacts for the authenticated account.

list-team-booking-types.description: Lists booking types for the specified team.

list-team-bookings.description: Lists bookings for the specified team.

list-team-users.description: Lists users in the specified team.

list-teams.description: Lists teams the authenticated user can access

remove-team-user.description: Removes a user from the specified team.
